description: The plot illustrates the loss over training time for two different methods, Vanilla and SepLLM, in the context of accelerating large language models by compressing one segment into one separator. The x-axis represents the training time in seconds, ranging from 0 to 250,000 seconds, with tick labels at intervals of 50,000 seconds. The y-axis represents the loss, with values ranging from 2.40 to 2.75, and tick labels at intervals of 0.05. The Vanilla method is represented by a purple line with triangle markers, while the SepLLM method is represented by a red line with circle markers. Both lines show a decreasing trend in loss as training time increases, with the loss values starting at approximately 2.70 for Vanilla and 2.65 for SepLLM at the beginning of the training time and converging to a loss value of around 2.50 by the end of the training time. The plot also includes a green dashed horizontal line at the loss value of 2.50, indicating a threshold or target loss value.
